scope: Three different appearances and sub-concepts. Humanoid stage identity retained; not three poses of the same shell.

images.visual_qa: Appearance changed to sealed oval funeral mask/canopy and organ-throat collar, vertical rib-shutter humanoid chest, squared hip guards, three curved external resonance tubes and supported back rack. One hand silences throat, other resists winding. Complete two-arm/two-leg body and frame; no human face or internal pin drum. Distinct from B framed plates and C bells.

images.visual_qa: Three offset closed rectangular head slabs, asymmetric navy shutter/ivory rib chest, short rounded pelvis guards, reverse-bound arms and six framed exterior sound plates.
